node.statement: Apply validated node 1.3 to the now correctly typed element xy in M_n tensor J: ||T_n(xy)-v_n(xy)||<=D*e||xy||<=D*e||x||||y||. Since v is an extended alpha-inclusion, def-extended-delta-inclusion says v_n is an alpha-homomorphism at every n; its multiplicative clause gives ||v_n(xy)-v_n(x)v_n(y)||<=alpha||x||||y||<=e||x||||y|| because alpha<=alpha+epsilon=e. These are precisely the first two telescope bounds.
